status: exact single-mass normalization map of the 2025 electron-neutron pseudoscalar product bound

source.title: Constraints on Axion Mediated Dipole-Dipole Interactions

normalization.nucleonQualification: c_n is an effective neutron axial coefficient after quark spin fractions and threshold matching; it is not fixed by setting the elementary Dirac coefficient to 1/8

comparison.decision: for c_n=c_e the 2015 electron-electron plateau is about 154 times stronger in the common derivative coupling; the 2025 result is complementary because it constrains c_e c_n rather than c_e^2

decision: At m_phi approximately 30 microeV the 2025 null result implies A/|c_e c_n|>8.00e5 GeV^2 and B/|c_e c_n|>8.89e32. It adds neutron flavor tomography but does not determine the hadronic coefficient c_n or supersede the electron-electron bound under equal effective couplings.
